sources.detail: All 6 registered pages fetched fresh by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 196-343 KB on disk (sizes read off the written files, not curl's size_download, which reports the compressed length under --compressed); r.jina.ai deliberately not attempted (IP-403 on this host). <style> stripped BEFORE parsing because the tier-list CSS ships inline, and exactly one <table class="tier-list"> asserted per page. Letter taken from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster (never split positionally — "Vengeance Demon Hunter" splits to class "Hunter"). Counts reconciled BEFORE the merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40 and M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched. ZERO letters moved — all 80 byte-identical to stored, confirmed by a pre-merge diff and then by apply-ratings landing a no-op. Each page's JSON-LD dateModified was re-read, not carried forward, and is unchanged from the stored published value: raid DPS 2026-08-30, raid healer 2026-09-01, raid tank 2026-08-29, M+ DPS 2026-08-30, M+ healer 2026-08-30, M+ tank 2026-08-30. The snapshot did not ADVANCE: it was already 2026-09-05 from the earlier nightly, and this run re-verified it live rather than moving it.

Both registered pages fetched fresh by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB. Parsed from tier__tier / tier__title / data-original-title and resolved by ROSTER MATCH, never by container position — which is again what rejects the M+ page's extra tierlists, whose 8 entries are the dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale) and are exactly the 8 unmatched labels reported. Raid 40/40, M+ 40/40, 0 spec rows unmatched. ZERO letters moved. The pages' own "Last Updated" lines, read out of the paragraph itself, are unchanged at 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+) — the honest explanation for a static parse. Era-verified from the ranking bodies: both self-identify as Midnight Season 2 and both carry all three Demon Hunter specs including Devourer; seasonVerified stays s2. Method carries no published field in the registry, so there is nothing to cross-check against the published-evidence artifact. Snapshot was already 2026-09-05 and was re-verified, not advanced.

Recipe exactly as recorded: unescape \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST, then locate [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] — never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml, since the raid-healer page carries a 1.2 KB decoy call — segment on [tier-label ...]X[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace (Wowhead writes a trailing space inside the tag), and resolve each [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug. Exactly one tier-list block per page; raid 27/7/6 = 40, M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 0 unmatched slugs.
